title: enqueueChangeDeployments
responsibility: Queues an ordered automatic deployment chain for a verified source commit, capped at preprod.

inputs.name: enqueueChangeDeployments.root
inputs.description: The repository root supplied to each deployment review and forwarded to deployment-plugin discovery. This function passes it through without resolving or defaulting it.

inputs.name: enqueueChangeDeployments.input
inputs.type: { environment: DeploymentEnvironment; commit: string; projectId: string | null }
inputs.description: The target environment, source commit, and nullable project identity used to build each queued review. changeEnvironment expands dev to dev, stage to dev and stage, and preprod or prod to dev, stage, and preprod; prod is never scheduled here.

inputs.name: enqueueChangeDeployments.runtime
inputs.description: A required deployment plugin and activity service, with optional execution and health callbacks. The function uses the plugin for reviews, reserves activity capacity, then schedules jobs through the activity service; the callbacks are forwarded to deployment execution.

outputs.name: enqueueChangeDeployments
outputs.description: The activity records returned by activities.schedule, in the order selected by changeEnvironment. The function returns after scheduling and chains each later activity on the previous activity’s wait promise; it does not await completed deployments.

errors.name: Deployment review, capacity, or scheduling failure
errors.description: Throws an Error when a review reports blockers or activity capacity or scheduling fails; errors from environment mapping or deployment review also reject the call. Failures of queued execution are recorded on their activities and are not awaited by this function.
